tool_admission: Discover with tools/list and check project authorization with paper_capabilities.

tools.description: Read metadata, export native ResourceLink, return a PNG/JPEG as actual MCP image (action=image), get <=256KiB chunk, or copy to a NEW candidate file. A returned resource is not proof of visual review.
tools.name: paper_build_artifact

tools.description: Resolve the registered current manuscript and its literal dependencies; returns exact source and input SHA256, bounded input paths, and configured engine/workdir. Read only; does not execute TeX.
tools.name: paper_build_plan

tools.description: Read actual provider build state, output identity and bounded log tail. rb IDs are provider IDs, not native Job IDs.
tools.name: paper_build_status

tools.description: Read the selected project identity, configured tool admission and action-level capability states. Pure configuration discovery does not probe services or grant any write permission. Host, Provider and Native identities remain distinct.
tools.name: paper_capabilities

tools.description: Return bounded outgoing references deposited with Crossref. Coverage may be incomplete; incoming citations are unsupported. No recursive crawling.
tools.name: paper_citation_graph

tools.description: Read real Google Drive metadata using the configured local Publisher OAuth grant. Any accessible valid file/folder ID may be checked; omit file_ids to verify authorization and the configured project folder. Only metadata GETs, no downloads, sharing changes or publication permission. Optional checks compare server SHA256, byte size and parent; unavailable server checksums stay unverified.
tools.name: paper_drive_verify

tools.description: Create/edit/rename/delete authorized candidate files through native revision-checked transactions. Delete/rename need explicit authorized=true. Read before existing-file changes.
tools.name: paper_edit_files

tools.description: Read text from 1..4 selected pages of a hash-bound project PDF in the existing isolated parser. Returns actual byte/text hashes, page count and truncation. Does not render, OCR, download attachments or establish scientific support.
tools.name: paper_evidence_read

tools.description: Submit isolated Python, SVG or TikZ build; Python writes to PAPER_OUTPUT_DIR and reads immutable input. Returns asynchronous build_id.
tools.name: paper_figure_build

tools.description: Look up a registered manuscript or figure by exact version, revision, language and role. Returns its immutable identity and verified Drive reference where available. Use part=content for bounded original bytes. Missing keys do not start a search.
tools.name: paper_index_get

tools.description: Capture a working subrevision from explicit changed files and selected figure versions. Unchanged objects are inherited. The request budget applies to this edit, not to the total size of the manuscript. A working revision never creates a formal release.
tools.name: paper_index_revise

tools.description: Search public scholarly metadata through the project-enabled provider. Returns candidates with provenance, never automatically confirmed references. No fulltext download or Zotero write.
tools.name: paper_literature_search

tools.description: Manage immutable bNNN manuscript build records without creating a new paper version. submit snapshots the complete project excluding managed history; trusted targets execute only their exact dependency plan, separately bound to the full restorable source archive. status/list/read verify archived hashes; restore creates a NEW directory containing the complete project-relative source tree.
tools.name: paper_manuscript_build

tools.description: Read one indexed material handoff by change ID, manifest SHA, or the current handoff pointer.
tools.name: paper_material_get

tools.description: Inspect Crossref license/link metadata for a DOI. Open access remains unknown until independently verified; links are not fetched and no full text is downloaded.
tools.name: paper_open_access_lookup

tools.description: Open the current binding's explicitly configured immutable bilingual PDF viewer. This read-only conversation-panel entrypoint takes no arguments and never switches project.
tools.name: paper_pdf_preview
tools.title: 双语原稿预览

tools.description: Render selected PDF pages and report the total page count. Pages are 1-based; use pages or inclusive page_ranges. Large manuscripts default to a bounded preview.
tools.name: paper_pdf_review

tools.description: Create/edit/export native PPTX, or import_drive one exact stored PPTX from the bound project Publisher folder to a new writable figure path. import_drive defaults to dry_run; apply needs authorized=true and returns an import receipt directly.
tools.name: paper_pptx_edit

tools.description: Inspect validated PPTX native objects, geometry and package metadata with bounded paging.
tools.name: paper_pptx_inspect

tools.description: Discover project entrypoints. Indexed projects return bounded entrypoints by default; view=evidence explicitly requests the verified evidence context.
tools.name: paper_project_context

tools.description: Bounded local file index with types and hashes; no automatic scientific fact verification.
tools.name: paper_project_inventory

tools.description: Choose exactly one: review_pdf displays one current source-bound marked or controlled clean TeX build PDF in its bound private folder and returns a verified link without creating a paper version; version submits an existing formal archive job. A managed formal selection may use <working-version>@rev-NNN to check the exact promoted revision. A bare rev-NNN does not identify its parent manuscript. An unpromoted working revision returns FORMAL_ARCHIVE_REQUIRED with the review and promotion routes. Optional resume_build_id only recovers a failed formal publication. Never changes sharing.
tools.name: paper_publish_to_drive

tools.description: Read at most eight files per native batch. Returned numeric read_revision is required for existing-file edits.
tools.name: paper_read_files

tools.description: Inspect BibTeX keys, duplicates, and citations. Use paper_edit_files to create or change source BibTeX; does not fabricate reference metadata.
tools.name: paper_reference_manage

tools.description: Resolve one DOI using public Crossref metadata. Preserves provider identity, retrieval time and uncertainty; does not merge conflicting sources or imply claim support.
tools.name: paper_reference_resolve

tools.description: Read the configured project continuity JSON and verify referenced file hashes. Scientific acceptance and build statuses are not automatically trusted. Use paper_read_files/edit_files for revision-checked updates and existing artifact/Drive tools for delivery.
tools.name: paper_research_state

tools.description: Read hash-bound formal or lightweight Drive PDF comments. Select version or review_receipt_id; version=review:<receipt SHA> is an explicit lightweight compatibility locator. Collect defaults to dry_run. Apply requires a saved source binding and an explicit acceptance reply by the current Drive user in the same thread.
tools.name: paper_review_comments

tools.description: Show a marked-up review against the current edition. Comments and previews leave its version unchanged. Apply only confirmed changes; a major version needs separate explicit authorization.
tools.name: paper_review_proposal

tools.description: Read actual native server/Runner/plugin and the currently authorized project.
tools.name: paper_runtime_status

tools.description: Stage an immutable bilingual section from a captured material handoff, or compare two revisions. Stage defaults to dry_run.
tools.name: paper_section

tools.description: Open a download card for bilingual PDFs. Select section_id+revision or an immutable full-manuscript archive version, with its exact EN/ZH build IDs. No Drive account required.
tools.name: paper_section_delivery

tools.description: Plan/status or explicitly authorized source sync with the existing local Drive Publisher. Default dry_run. Gateway apply-sync returns a durable background task immediately; poll status with the SAME request_id. Duplicates never start a second active worker. Completed historical requests return receipt_only=true without new remote verification. Reconcile a lost worker by explicitly repeating the same apply arguments; changed configuration is rejected. Review import stays scoped and create-only. Large bytes stay local-to-Drive, not in MCP responses.
tools.name: paper_source_sync

tools.description: Capture authorized source revision and submit isolated LaTeX build. expected_input_sha256 optionally fences the full literal dependency plan, including BibTeX changes. Optional resume_build_id creates a NEW audited recovery job only for an inactive failed TeX job with unchanged source snapshot and engine options. Use a new stable request_id; the old job remains unchanged. Query paper_build_status; completion is distinct from delivery.
tools.name: paper_tex_build_submit

tools.description: Compare two verified source snapshots and return file hashes and bounded text diffs.
tools.name: paper_version_compare

tools.description: Legacy derive remains compatible. Opt-in managed versions support status/checkout/restore/rollback/stage/dependency/revise/figure/select/promote/activate. stage copies a frozen support file to working/deps for editing; dependency captures an immutable dep-NNN candidate; revise selects dependency candidates (dep-NNN/base/absent), figure candidates and, with an explicit structure declaration and reason, adds or removes figure/table slots. New writes default dry_run and require exact expected state hashes and request_id; frozen revisions and published versions cannot be edited. Build and Drive publication remain separate existing tools.
tools.name: paper_version_derive

tools.description: List immutable local paper versions. Default verification=full hashes every member. Explicit verification=manifest reads only archive metadata and returns verified=false, members_verified=false. Optional version selects one archive for discovery or full verification.
tools.name: paper_version_list

tools.description: Publish a new immutable local version from completed builds, source snapshots, outputs, logs and changelog.
tools.name: paper_version_save

tools.description: Preflight or import ONE explicitly authorized hash-pinned source, deduplicating exact DOI and preserving project citation keys. Defaults to dry_run. Selected Zotero 10 local SDK backend binds an explicit collection key; writes require a pinned server and separately granted local key. Older Zotero is blocked; no UI Connector import.
tools.name: paper_zotero_add_reference

tools.description: Inspect the selected local SDK backend or query/create ONE project-authorized collection. Defaults to dry_run; writes require explicit authorization and Zotero 10 local grant. update is disabled. No arbitrary route, deletion, attachment download or automatic authorization.
tools.name: paper_zotero_manage

tools.description: Read Windows Zotero Local API through the installed hash-pinned skill. Only explicitly scoped project references are visible: exact DOI or pinned parent key/title; per-parent Collection membership constraints further narrow access when configured. Metadata includes parent/library/version and separates native export keys from observed persistent keys. No imports, attachment paths/fulltext, arbitrary API routes or file writes. export_preview preserves the project citation key and writes nothing.
tools.name: paper_zotero_read

tools.description: Plan project-cited Zotero entries, preserving project citation keys and all existing manual BibTeX bytes. Defaults to dry_run; appending missing entries requires separate configured permission, authorized=true, latest numeric read_revision and SHA256. Does not rewrite TeX or delete references.
tools.name: paper_zotero_sync_bibtex

tools.description: Compare explicit TeX citation keys, project BibTeX and real scoped Zotero bibliographic identities. Reports incomplete TeX coverage and conflicts separately. Claim support remains unverified; no PDF/fulltext retrieval or scientific evidence inference.
tools.name: paper_zotero_verify_citations
